title: PrimalSeq: Generation of Tiled Virus Amplicons for MiSeq Sequencing
author: Nate Matteson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bez7jf9n
materials: Discard supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Proceed immediately to cleanup or store at 4°C.

steps.title: Prepare Primer Pools
steps.instruction: Create two primer pools by mixing equal volumes of each 10 µM primer, with specific concentration adjustments for normalization.

substeps.instruction: Mix equal volumes of 10 µM primers for standard pools.
Pool primers indicated by '*' at 50 µM.
Pool primers indicated by '**' at 100 µM.
Ensure contamination primers (Forward: AATGTCGCAGGCACTTGTCC; Reverse: GGTCAGAGCTGTCTCCTGCT) are at the same concentration as individual primer pairs in the pool.

steps.title: Prepare Barcode Indices
steps.instruction: Dilute NEXTflex Dual-Indexed DNA Barcodes to create a working stock.

substeps.instruction: Dilute NEXTflex Dual-Indexed DNA Barcodes 1:100 to reach a concentration of 250 nM.
Select unique barcodes for each sample, avoiding barcodes used in recent runs.
Centrifuge caps before opening to prevent cross-contamination; open only one index at a time.

steps.title: Generate Barcode Spike-ins
steps.instruction: Generate 96 unique barcode transcripts using step-out PCR with a common insert (Zea mays adh1 mRNA) and variable 20bp forward/reverse primers.

steps.title: Isolate Viral RNA and Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Extract viral RNA and convert it to cDNA using high-fidelity synthesis.

substeps.instruction: Isolate viral RNA using Omega Viral DNA/RNA kit, Trizol, or equivalent.
Synthesize cDNA using a high-fidelity kit (e.g., SuperScript IV VILO Master Mix).

steps.title: Prepare Spike-in Working Stock
steps.instruction: Dilute Barcoded Spike-ins for sample addition.

substeps.instruction: Dilute Barcoded Spike-ins 1:100,000 to obtain a concentration of 38 fM.
Select a unique spike-in for each sample.
Centrifuge caps and open only one index at a time to avoid cross-contamination.

steps.title: Perform Initial PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the target sequences using the prepared primer pools.

substeps.instruction: Store samples at 4°C (same day use) or -20°C (within a week) until PCR.
Prepare two PCR reactions per sample (one for each primer pool).
Run the thermocycler cycles.
Verify products by running 5 µL of each on a 1% agarose gel; look for a visible 400 bp band.

steps.title: Purify PCR Products
steps.instruction: Clean up the PCR products using Mag-Bind TotalPure NGS beads.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate Mag-Bind TotalPure NGS beads to room temperature and vortex until homogenous.
Bring PCR product volume to 25 µL with water.
Add 50 µL of beads to 25 µL of PCR product, mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Place tubes on a magnetic stand until the solution is clear.
Wash with 200 µL of 80% EtOH for 30 seconds; discard wash.
Repeat the 80% EtOH wash and remove as much EtOH as possible.
Air dry on the magnet for 5 minutes.
Remove from magnet and add 20 µL of nuclease-free water; mix by pipetting.
Place on magnet stand and transfer the clear supernatant to new tubes.

steps.title: Quantify Purified DNA
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of the purified PCR products.

substeps.instruction: Quantify 1 µL of each product using the Qubit High Sensitivity DNA kit (expected range: 10-100 ng/µL).

steps.title: Combine Amplicon Pools
steps.instruction: Merge the products from the two primer pools for library preparation.

substeps.instruction: Combine 25-50 ng of DNA from primer pool 1 and 2 (total 50-100 ng) into a final volume of 12.5 µL using nuclease-free water.
Alternatively, keep pool products separate (50-100 ng each) to monitor cross-contamination.

steps.title: End Repair and Ligation
steps.instruction: Perform end repair using the Kapa Hyper prep kit.

substeps.instruction: Combine Kapa Hyper prep kit components for end repair.
Run thermocycler cycles.
Incubate at 20°C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Purify Ligation Product
steps.instruction: Clean the ligation product using Mag-Bind TotalPure NGS beads.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate beads to room temperature and vortex.
Add 22 µL of beads to 27.5 µL of ligation product, mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand until clear.
Wash twice with 200 µL of 80% EtOH (30 seconds per wash).
Air dry on magnet for 5 minutes.
Add 20 µL of nuclease-free water and mix.
Transfer 15 µL of the clear supernatant to new tubes for library amplification.

steps.title: Library Amplification and Final Purification
steps.instruction: Amplify the library and perform a final bead-based cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Run the library amplification thermocycler cycles.
Equilibrate Mag-Bind TotalPure NGS beads to room temperature and vortex.
Add 27.2 µL of beads to 34 µL of amplified product, mix, and incubate at RT for 10 minutes.
Place on magnetic stand until clear.
Wash twice with 200 µL of 80% EtOH (30 seconds per wash).
Air dry on magnet for 5 minutes.
Add 25 µL of Tris-EDTA or elution buffer and mix.
Transfer the clear supernatant to new tubes.

steps.title: Pool and Quality Control Libraries
steps.instruction: Quantify, pool, and verify the fragment size of the libraries.

substeps.instruction: Quantify 1 µL of each sample using the Qubit High Sensitivity DNA kit.
Pool equal concentrations (e.g., 1-10 ng) of each library.
Check fragment distribution using BioAnalyzer DNA 1000 kit (expected peak ~580 nt).
If ~180 bp adaptor dimers exist, repeat post-amplification cleanup.
Quantify the pooled library (1 µL) using Qubit (minimum 0.76 ng/µL required for 2 nM).

steps.title: Normalize Pooled Library
steps.instruction: Convert library concentration to molarity and dilute to 2 nM.

substeps.instruction: Calculate molarity: [nM] = [ng/µL] / ((ave. library size x 650)/1,000,000).
Dilute the pooled library to 2 nM in 10 mM TE.
(Optional) Verify molar concentration using Kapa Library Quantification kit.

steps.title: Prepare for MiSeq Loading
steps.instruction: Denature and dilute the pooled library for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Combine 10 µL of 2 nM pooled library with 10 µL of 0.1 N NaOH; mix and incubate 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add 980 µL of HT1 to reach a concentration of 20 pM.
Denature and dilute PhiX control to 20 pM.
Dilute to final loading concentration (typically 10-12 pM for MiSeq v2 or 14-16 pM for MiSeq v3).

steps.title: Sequence and Analyze
steps.instruction: Load the MiSeq and process the resulting data.

substeps.instruction: Load the MiSeq following user guides.
Analyze data using iVar and the PrimalSeq_Pipeline for consensus sequences and contamination estimation.
